property_description: 999 Chattahoochee Avenue is located in the heart of burgeoning Upper Westside neighborhood, which has become one of the Southeast's top dining, retail and entertainment destinations. The former industrial area has been transformed over the past ten or so years as developers have converted several former warehouses into adaptive re-use loft office projects and residents have flocked to several multi-family, townhouse, and single family developments. The increase in the day time population of higher end white collar jobs combined with the influx of the residential units has driven more retail and entertainment options such as TopGolf and Atlanta's emerging brewery district. Long known as a 'foodie' destination the Upper Westside is home to many of the Southeast's higher end fine dining restaurants as well as more causal long standing staples in Atlanta's dining scene.
